children: Constellation Brands entered into a Term Loan Credit Agreement for a delayed-draw term loan of up to $300 million to support general corporate purposes, including debt repayment. The facility allows up to two draws, carries interest at Term SOFR plus 0.700%–1.100% or Base Rate plus 0.000%–0.100% based on credit ratings, and includes a 0.075% ticking fee starting 30 days after signing. Commitments end by June 18, 2027 at the latest, and any funded Term Loans mature two years after the initial borrowing. The agreement includes customary covenants, including a minimum 2.50x interest coverage and a maximum 4.00x net leverage, with a temporary step-up following material acquisitions.
